senses.gloss: m. (פָּתָה) the principal or king-beam, common to two adjoining buildings, opp. to ראשים the cross-beams.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 13:2">Neg. XIII, 2</cite> <he>בית הבנוי ראש ופ׳</he> if a (twin-) house is built with cross-beam and king-beam common to both compartments.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 7:8">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VII, 8</cite> <cite ref="Q02170"><he>פתין</he></cite> ed. Zuck., v. <cite ref="Q02154"><he>פֶּתִי</he></cite>.]
